Get apps only from the Play Store, and look before you tap Install. Tap the developer name. A real bank app is published by the bank itself.

say: Most money lost online is not lost because criminals broke the bank. They trick someone, or take control of their phone number.
First, they gather your details from phishing or social media.

panel.heading: How a SIM-swap scam works
items: Your details are stolen by phishing
A fake SIM replacement is requested
Your SIM suddenly shows No service
The criminal now receives your OTPs

say: Then they get someone at a network outlet to move your number onto their new SIM.

panel.heading: How a SIM-swap scam works
items: Your details are stolen by phishing

Your SIM suddenly shows No service
The criminal now receives your OTPs

say: Your phone shows No service for a long time, while people near you on the same network have signal.

say: Step one. Borrow another phone and call your network's customer care. Report a possible SIM swap and ask them to block the number.

panel.heading: If you suspect a SIM swap: act in minutes
items: Borrow a phone. Call your network to block the number
Call your bank's official number to freeze accounts
Change your email password, check 2-Step
Visit your network and bank with your ID
Keep a record of times, calls and references

say: Step two. Call your bank's official number and ask them to freeze your account and cards.

say: Step three. Change your email password, because email is used to reset bank logins.

say: Step four. Visit your network's office with your ID to recover your number, and report the fraud to your bank in writing.

say: Step five. Write down times, calls and reference numbers.
Prepare today. During a SIM swap your phone may not work, so save your bank's fraud line and emergency block code in your contacts, and on paper at home.

say: Hauwa in Jos is selling two bags of rice. The buyer shows her a screenshot of a transfer.

card.title: Hauwa and the fake alert
card.note: Her bank app showed that nothing arrived.

say: He says he sent 38,000 naira. Then he says he sent 83,000 by mistake, and asks her to refund 45,000.

card.title: Hauwa and the fake alert
rows: Then says it was by mistake
card.note: Her bank app showed that nothing arrived.

say: Hauwa does not trust screenshots or SMS. She opens her own bank app. No money arrived at all. She keeps her rice, refunds nothing, and warns the other traders.
Trust only the balance inside your own bank app. And never tell anyone your PIN, OTP, password or BVN.

card.title: Hauwa and the fake alert

card.note: Her bank app showed that nothing arrived.

say: Use a transaction PIN that is different from your phone lock and ATM PIN, turn on fingerprint login, and set a daily limit that matches what you really send.

panel.heading: Do and do not
left: A transaction PIN all its own
Fingerprint login in the bank app
Transfer limits that fit your needs
right: Ignore alerts you do not understand

say: Do not use your birthday or 1234. Read every debit alert. And always read the account name before you confirm, so money does not go to the wrong person.

say: Google Drive keeps your files online, safe even if your phone is lost. Tap plus, then Scan, to turn a certificate into a clean PDF.

cards.d: Tap plus, then Scan. Rename it clearly and save it in a folder.
Viewer for most people. Editor only for trusted team members.
Never set ID, BVN slips or bank statements to Anyone with the link.

say: Joy in Calabar applied for a job from her phone. She scanned her documents, and shared each one as Viewer with the employer's email.

say: Mercy in Uyo joined her first WODDI Institute class on Google Meet. She installed the app at midday, charged her phone, sat near a window for 4G, and joined early with her microphone and camera off.
She used the chat and raised her hand. Never post meeting links publicly, and an interview that asks for a fee or your ATM card is a scam.

panel.heading: Before every online class
items: Charge your phone and check data
Install Meet or Zoom in advance
Join five minutes early
Mute your microphone on entry
Camera off unless asked

say: To remember. Check the developer, and never install APKs. If your SIM loses service while others have signal, act at once.
Trust only your bank app balance. Share files as Viewer and Restricted. And keep meeting links private.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Check the developer. Never install APKs from chats
No service while others have signal? Act at once
Trust your bank app balance, not screenshots
Share files as Viewer and keep them Restricted
Mute on entry and keep meeting links private
